title: Servex never loses a wake: the awaken-then-sleep race, live pid counts, a queue that keeps every entry

message.text: The live patch (sleep() refuses for 60 s after a wake, b8630fb3) is on michael/dev. One Sonnet minion, never-lose-a-wake ($12), builds the deeper version: the idle clock resets on awaken, "working" counts only live processes, a start that hasn't begun in 60 s is put back at the head of the queue with its messages, escalation writes to your Inbox when its card is missing, a message to a sleeping or starting agent is held and never dropped, and a one-minute reconcile of rows against processes — with a regression test for the awaken-then-sleep race. Brief: /framework/ai/2026-10-01/never-lose-a-wake/. It is queued at the head of the spawn gate.

Clarity note: the reply above is one ~90-word sentence listing all six build parts — over the 60-word limit and not a ten-second read. Clearer version: "A wake message was lost: sleep() raced awaken() and marked a phantom "working" agent. The live patch landed (b8630fb3, refuses sleep for 60s after a wake). A $12 Sonnet minion is building the deeper fix now — six parts plus a regression test, queued at the head of the spawn gate. Brief: /framework/ai/2026-10-01/never-lose-a-wake/." The brief itself (requirements.md) is fine as-is — it's agent-facing.

A second lost-work case for this minion: the 21:42 Servex restart emptied spawn-queue.json and three queued minions (this one included) vanished. Re-queued at position 1; the restart-survival fix is now part of item 5.

Landed e74f4d8a on michael/dev. A message to a sleeping or just-woken agent can no longer vanish: the idle clock resets before the registry is told (the actual race), a phantom "working" row with a dead process is excluded from the 5-slot cap and gets dormant, not idle, so it still answers, a stuck "starting" row is retried with its held messages, an escalation with no card falls back to the page Inbox, every queue push now reports whether it landed and replays what didn't on the next wake, a once-a-minute reconcile sweeps the whole registry, and a spawn the pool or OpenRouter pace guard refuses waits at the head of the queue instead of dropping - its parent is told once either way. Proof: Servex/agents/awaken-race.test.mjs (new, 11 checks) plus all 9 existing Servex/agents/*.test.mjs files, 265 checks total, all passing. Fresh-eyes review (light) passed clean, 4 follow-up notes logged in task.jsonl (an untested reconcile adopt-path edge, a non-self-clearing OpenRouter refusal reason, Log.js's own name-length limit, and this report itself). Needs a Servex restart to pick up the new code - not done by me.
